axes.gltf: Y-up (converted by the Blender glTF exporter)
axes.vehicle_origin: centre of the S1 aft plane (bottom of aft skirt), Z=0

accuracy_levels.standard-based: built to a published engineering standard (ISO etc.)
accuracy_levels.representative: the part exists on the real vehicle, but geometry is a plausible estimate (no public drawings)

detail_tiers.A: hero detail, real fastener geometry, ≤40k tris

sources.FUG: SpaceX Falcon User's Guide (2025-05-09) — Project doc claude/rocket-3d-knowledge-base.md §1.3, §2.3
sources.SP125: NASA SP-125 Design of Liquid Propellant Rocket Engines (NTRS 19710019929)
sources.STD: ISO fastener / gear standards via FreeCAD Fasteners & Gears workbenches
sources.WP-F9FT: Wikipedia 'Falcon 9 Full Thrust' (accessed 2026-10-02): first stage 41.2 m, second stage 13.8 m, interstage 4.5 m, fairing 13.2 m x 5.2 m, total 70 m
sources.WP-F9PROTO: Wikipedia 'Falcon 9 prototypes' (accessed 2026-10-02): F9R Dev1 landing legs, 4 legs, span ~18 m, telescoping piston on an A-frame, helium-actuated. Leg length / section / attach points are NOT published -> representative
